# The Invictus Project

> Mental performance coaching for elite athletes, teams, and coaches across Olympic and world championship sports.

The Invictus Project, founded by Stephen Feeney through Invictus International, specializes in mental resilience and sports psychology training. The organization works with elite rowing programs, Olympic athletes, and top sporting institutions to develop mental performance capabilities at the highest competitive levels.

## Key Topics

- Mental resilience
- Sports psychology
- Athlete performance coaching
- Mental performance coaching
- Olympic athletes
- Rowing expertise
- Team development
- Elite sports training
- World championship success
- Team cohesion
- Stephen Feeney
- Invictus International
- Performance development
- Athlete management

## Core Programs

- [Athletes Program](https://www.theinvictusproject.co.uk/athletes-prog): Athlete mental resilience and performance coaching programs
- [Coaches and Teams Program](https://www.theinvictusproject.co.uk/coaches-prog): Team and coach mental performance development programs for elite sports
